def decode(target):
    KEY = "orbit"
    # First reverse the target since encode reverses at the end
    reversed_target = target[::-1]
    out = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed_target):
        shift = ord(KEY[i % len(KEY)]) - ord("a")
        # Reverse the shift: (ord(ch) - ord("a") - shift - i) % 26
        original_ord = (ord(ch) - ord("a") - shift - i) % 26 + ord("a")
        out.append(chr(original_ord))
    return "".join(out)

result = decode('kkbeqsz')
print(result)

        shift = ord(KEY[i % len(KEY)]) - ord("a")
        out.append(chr((ord(ch) - ord("a") + shift + i) % 26 + ord("a")))
    return "".join(reversed(out))

print("Verification:", encode(result))
